ApprovalReason.description: Why a quotation or an order needs approval before it is issued or confirmed.

BarcodeType.description: What kind of code a barcode is; EAN-13 and GTIN values follow GS1 and carry a check digit.

CreditHoldPolicy.description: What a customer's manual credit hold does to a new order.

CustomerAddressType.description: What a customer's address is used for.

CustomerType.description: Who the customer is; fixed once created.

PriceSource.description: Where a line's unit price came from; the price is a snapshot either way.

ProductType.description: Whether a product is held in stock.

PurchaseOrderStatus.description: Where a purchase order is in its life.

PurchaseRequestStatus.description: Where a purchase request is in its life.

PurchasingDocumentAction.description: A step in a purchasing document's history.

PurchasingDocumentType.description: A kind of purchasing document; each has its own number series per branch and fiscal year.

ReturnCondition.description:
The state returned goods arrive in. Only goods confirmed fit for resale go back into sellable stock in V1; the other
conditions are refused explicitly (Inventory has no quarantine or non-sellable stock yet), never restocked.

SalesDeliveryStatus.description: Where a delivery note is in its life.

SalesDocumentAction.description: A step in a sales document's history.

SalesDocumentType.description: A kind of sales document; each has its own number series per branch and fiscal year.

SalesInvoiceStatus.description: Where a sales invoice is in its life.

SalesOrderStatus.description: Where a sales order is in its life.

SalesQuotationStatus.description: Where a quotation is in its life. An issued quotation past its validity date shows as expired.

SalesReturnStatus.description: Where a customer return is in its life.

StockCountAction.description: A step in a stock count's history.

StockCountStatus.description: Where a stock count is in its life.

StockDocumentAction.description: A step in a stock document's history.

StockDocumentStatus.description: Where a stock document is in its life.

StockDocumentType.description: What a stock document does; each type has its own number series.

StockStatus.description: The condition stock is in; only available stock counts as sellable.

StockTransferAction.description: A step in a transfer's history.

StockTransferStatus.description: Where a transfer is in its life.

SupplierAddressType.description: What a supplier's address is used for.

SupplierInvoiceStatus.description: Where a supplier invoice is in its life.

SupplierReturnStatus.description: Where a supplier return is in its life.

TaxTreatment.description: How a line's tax is treated in cost.

TrackingMode.description: How individual units of a stock item are told apart.
